The keys in the cover category control the front and back cover images. See covers.html for examples and more information.

Key Value Type Example

back-image

image macro | path
(default: not set)

 
cover:
  back:
    image: image:solid-cover.pdf[]

front-image

image macro | path
(default: not set)

 
cover:
  front:
    image: image:cover.pdf[page=2]
